answer:
Steve ran 3 miles in 24 minutes. Therefore, half of Steve's time is \( \frac{24}{2} = 12 \) minutes. Jordan ran 2 miles in this half time, which is 12 minutes. 

To find Jordan's running rate, we calculate his speed:
\[
\text{Speed} = \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Time}} = \frac{2 \text{ miles}}{12 \text{ minutes}} = \frac{1}{6} \text{ miles per minute}
\]

To determine the time it would take Jordan to run 5 miles, we use the formula:
\[
\text{Time} = \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Speed}} = \frac{5 \text{ miles}}{\frac{1}{6} \text{ miles per minute}} = 5 \times 6 = 30 \text{ minutes}
\]

Thus, the time it would take Jordan to run 5 miles is \boxed{30} minutes.
